description: This file defines the DatatableEntryCreatedBusinessEvent class, representing a specific event in the data table handling system of the Apache Fineract project. It extends a base event class and implements an interface indicating it is not external.

classes.name: DatatableEntryCreatedBusinessEvent
classes.description: A class representing an event triggered when a data table entry is created, extending DatatableEntryBusinessEvent and implementing NoExternalEvent.
